title: RA-15 Contextuality Auditor for Enterprise LLM Agents: Reproducibility Artifacts v1.1
description: Complete reproducibility artifacts for the RA-15 method and negative-results study. The release contains synthetic prompts, frozen prompt matrices, raw and repaired Qwen 3.6 and OpenRouter Gemma 4 outputs, canonical Contextuality-by-Default summaries, analysis and validation code, analytic fixtures, protocols, and reports. The corrected Phase 1.3 result is a canonical contextuality null across all groups. No human-subject, customer, production tenant, or personally identifiable data are included.
